items.title: Kaiji: Ultimate Survivor
items.reason: A psychological survival-gambling thriller built around explicit game rules, deception, betrayals, traps and counter-plans. Across its two-season series identity, Kaiji repeatedly has to infer opponents' cheating methods, exploit constrained rules and survive escalating high-stakes contests whose punishments include mutilation, death and crushing debt. Its strongest DNA fit is psychological strategy, cat-and-mouse pressure, suspense, rule discovery, brutality and a distinctive dark visual presentation rather than supernatural powers.
